excludedHistoricalRecord.name: Vila Caniçado
excludedHistoricalRecord.reason: Administrative-post/urban-seat record. It is not promoted as a current LOCALITY because current INE territorial statistics report 7 localities for Guijá while the reconciled historical set contains 8 including Vila Caniçado under the Vila de Caniçado administrative post.

evidence: INE Gaza Statistical Yearbook 2024: Guijá = 4 administrative posts and 7 localities.
INE Guijá district statistics 2019-2023: Vila de Caniçado is treated as one of the district territorial/administrative-post units alongside Chivonguene, Mubanguene and Nalazi.
INE/MozGIS 2017 historical layer: 8 reconciled candidate records, one of which is Vila Caniçado under the Vila de Caniçado administrative post.

excludedHistoricalRecord.name: Vila de Mandlakazi
excludedHistoricalRecord.reason: Urban vila/municipal-seat record. It is not promoted as a current LOCALITY because current INE territorial statistics report 14 localities for Mandlakazi while the reconciled historical set contains 15 including this vila record.

evidence: INE Gaza Statistical Yearbook 2024: Mandlakazi = 5 administrative posts and 14 localities.
INE Mandlakazi district indicators 2020: Mandlakazi = 5 administrative posts and 14 localities; district seat identified as Vila Sede.
INE/MozGIS 2017 historical layer: 15 reconciled candidate records, one of which is Vila de Mandlakazi.
